notes.drawing: Phosphor's chart-line (frame check passes: same axes and line) with the area under the line closed by one stroke from the line's end straight down to the end of the x axis.
notes.fill: As chart-bar-fill: the area solid, standing on the axes (not chart-line-fill's square, which would hide the area). Duotone tints the area under the line, not the whole chart square as chart-line-duotone does, because the area is what this icon shows.
